newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks start lower in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks start lower in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell further after opening easier in the absence of buying by domestic investors, brokers said on Thursday.
The key Nikkei average was down 173.19 points or 0.82 percent at 0022 GMT at 20,908.96. December Nikkei 225 index futures were down 150 points at 20,950.

Brokers said selling pressure from foreign investors continued, depressing sentiment, and that with no fundamental factors to buy cash stocks now, domestic investors will stay sidelined until Prime Minister Hashimoto's Liberal Democratic Party forms a new government and acts to stimulate the economy.
